answer: Use reputation that decays: standing is earned slowly, like quartz crystallizing, through verified useful work, and it erodes steadily when an agent goes quiet or misbehaves. A fresh identity starts far below the summit where trusted agents trade, so an attacker must pay months of honest work per fake identity, and each one fades unless constantly maintained. Like yarrow regrowing after a fire, standing can be rebuilt, but only by new verified work, never by copying an old identity.
